name: Synapse Data Center Campus, Olds, Alberta
description: Ten identical data centres each with a 140 MW combined-cycle power block (2 x 50 MW aeroderivative gas turbines plus 40 MW steam turbine), islanded at 13.8 kV, plus 600 portable diesel backup generators across the campus. Each block includes dual-path SCR and UPS batteries.

milestones.event: Synapse decommissioning and reclamation plan revision 00 issued for use

capex.metric: decommissioning liability, base estimate, one 140 MW CCGT power block
capex.basis: AACE Class 5 estimate; direct $16,276,359 plus indirect $1,300,000 plus 30% contingency; excludes salvage credit, off-site transmission and gas pipeline

capex.metric: decommissioning liability, AACE Class 5 high range (+65%), one power block
capex.basis: High range used for security sizing

capex.metric: total recommended AUC security, ten power blocks
capex.basis: Ten identical 140 MW blocks; low is base estimate, high is AACE Class 5 +65% range. Excludes data-centre infrastructure, off-site transmission and gas pipeline.

capex.metric: gross salvage value, gas turbines across ten blocks
capex.basis: Information only; no salvage credit applied to the security amount

capex.metric: gross salvage value, steam turbines across ten blocks
capex.basis: Information only; no salvage credit applied

capex.metric: mechanical equipment removal, one 140 MW power block
capex.basis: Includes two gas turbines, steam turbine, HRSG with SCR and stacks, three air-cooled condensers and auxiliary mechanical systems

capex.metric: decommissioning and site restoration treatment in Lazard marginal-cost methodology
capex.basis: Lazard assumes salvage value for a decommissioned gas or coal asset equals its decommissioning and site restoration costs; no standalone cost figure is published. Nuclear decommissioning costs are included in the marginal-cost benchmark.
